constructs.label: Autonomy
constructs.role_prompt: How independently the work must be organized
constructs.candidate_prompt: How strongly the candidate prefers self-direction

constructs.label: Structure
constructs.role_prompt: How defined goals, routines, and requirements are
constructs.candidate_prompt: How strongly the candidate prefers predictable direction

constructs.label: Ambiguity tolerance
constructs.role_prompt: How often priorities or requirements are unclear or changing
constructs.candidate_prompt: How comfortable the candidate is acting amid uncertainty

constructs.label: Collaboration
constructs.role_prompt: How much coordination, pairing, and stakeholder work the role needs
constructs.candidate_prompt: How much the candidate prefers collaborative work

constructs.label: Technical mastery
constructs.role_prompt: How much deep learning and complex problem solving the role offers
constructs.candidate_prompt: How energizing the candidate finds skill development and hard problems

constructs.label: Pace/context switching
constructs.role_prompt: How often work requires urgency or shifting between priorities
constructs.candidate_prompt: How comfortable the candidate is with variety and shifting priorities
